answer_2.quote: We evaluate the translation quality for all 20 languages... using the sampled items as a proxy from two perspectives: consistency and faithfulness... 1) Aspect accuracy (Acc)... 2) chrF++... 3) BERTScore... 4) SBERT... 5) BLEU

answer_4.quote: For each language, we recruited three native speakers (with high proficiency in English) via Prolific... They rated the system output on four task-agnostic dimensions... Grammar, Fluency, Adequacy, and Code-Switching... Additionally... Aspect Term Translation.
answer_4.guideline: Rated on 5-scale from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) across five dimensions
